summary: Navient Solutions, as administrator for SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-1, filed an 8-K furnishing a preliminary remarketing memorandum to the remarketing agent for the trust's Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes, distributed to qualified institutional buyers. Exhibit 99.1 provides pool tables describing the trust student loan collateral as of the August 31, 2026 statistical disclosure date. The trust is a Delaware FFELP student-loan securitization; the notes are being reset rather than sold in a special situation. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch remarketing clearing spreads and pool performance.
